title: A run's full detail can show another artifact's native completion refusal under a reused run id
outcome: A run's full detail (GET /api/test-runs/{id}) carries a native completion refusal only from the registration, or retained registration or observation, of the artifact the detail was selected for, never from one under a reused run id for another request.
acceptance: test_run_native_completion_refusal_for_detail attaches a refusal only when the registration (live or retained) matches the request identity the exact or retained selection recorded for the detail; covered by a behaviour test in which a same-id registration for another request lends the detail nothing.
